comparison.objective: Reinstall a dishwasher lower filter and quarter-turn-lock its upper filter; candidate commissions a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Both include alignment followed by retained rotation. Record requires placing a broad filter under tabs, inserting a cup and rotating lugs past a detent; candidate requires hex-key unlocking, fine setting rotation, relocking and impact-based iteration.
comparison.success_condition: Record checks filter pose, lug angle, detent passage, clearance and stillness. Candidate checks dynamic stopping and post-lock retention; rebound, overload and drift thresholds are undeclared.
comparison.reason: Insertion and bayonet locking are materially different from adjusting a continuous parameter and validating its dynamic effect.
